card.line: The Euphrates is the great river of western Asia. In the Bible, people cross it, armies fight beside it, and a prophet's scroll sinks in it.

moments.title: Jacob Flees Laban
moments.text: Jacob left Laban in secret with his family and all his possessions. He crossed the Euphrates and headed for the hill country of Gilead.

moments.title: Josiah Goes Out to Meet Neco
moments.text: Neco king of Egypt marched up to fight at Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah went out to meet him. Neco said God had told him to hurry, but Josiah did not listen.

moments.title: The Ruined Loincloth
moments.text: The LORD told Jeremiah to hide a linen loincloth in a hole in the rocks at Perath. Many days later he dug it up, and it was ruined and of no use at all.

moments.title: Egypt Defeated at Carchemish
moments.text: The LORD spoke about Pharaoh Neco's army, which Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates. The warriors stumbled and fell by the river in the north.

moments.title: A Scroll Sunk in the River
moments.text: Jeremiah told Seraiah to read a scroll about Babylon's coming disaster aloud in Babylon. Then he was to tie a stone to it and cast it into the Euphrates, showing that Babylon will sink and never rise again.
